prompt: A designed desktop web application screen, 1536x1024, no browser chrome, no device frame: the "splice" console (a local gateway that runs one developer's coding-agent sessions on several model backends called heads), Teams page, dark theme. VISUAL SYSTEM, THE STRIP BAY: every session, head and message is a printed paper strip held in a bay, like air-traffic-control flight progress strips: a strict horizontal field grid of fixed-width boxed fields, opaque pale strip (warm off-white #ECEAE2) with black ink, a 6px colored holder edge on the strip's left (green = ok, amber = warn, red = needs attention, grey = idle), tabular monospace figures right-aligned in every field, compact grotesque labels in lowercase. Bays are darker racks with a small printed label plate on top. The room is deep graphite (#1B1D1C), bays a step darker (#151716), rails and rules hairline (#3A3D3B). No glow, no neon, no blue-black, no gradients, no rounded cards, no icons. Charts are dark scope insets (near-black panel, thin light traces). REGIONS IN ORDER: (1) a narrow left rail, 9% width, listing the pages as small bay labels: fleet, turns, sessions, teams, projects, accounts, usage, settings, models, logs, compaction, mcp, doctor; "teams" is active and carries a holder-edge tab. (2) a thin fixed rule across the top: "splice" wordmark left; "14:02:11 local  12:02:11 utc"; "daemon ok" with a small green square; "nearest window: claudex acct-a 5h 74% resets 16:40"; "3 heads report no window". (3) a team header strip under the rule: "grailseeker-backend", goal "promoter bookkeeping lives on fly raw", repo "~/Documents/dev/infra/grailseeker-backend", "3 slots, 3 bound", "lead driving: gs-backend-claude". (4) MAIN AREA, 58% width: bays BY HEAD. Two tall bays side by side: bay "claude" holding the lead strip gs-backend-claude (fields: name, role lead, model fable, acct-a, 5h 74%, last turn 14:01, state "driving"); bay "claude-deepseek" holding two builder strips gs-backend-builder (state "building GS-41 done") and gs-backend-builder2 (state "reading packet GS-42", cocked a few degrees out of the rack because it just received a hand-off). Between the two bays, a message strip is caught MID HAND-OFF: sliding from the claude bay toward the deepseek bay, angled, with a motion trail of two faint ghost copies behind it, its fields reading "14:01  gs-backend-claude -> gs-backend-builder2  packet GS-42: dearm the machine-update schedule". (5) RIGHT COLUMN, 33% width: the team chat as a rack of message strips in time order, newest at the bottom, each strip with time, from -> to, and the message text, the lead's strips with a green holder edge and the builders' with a grey one; below the chat, a shorter bay labeled "activity, sampled every 30 s" listing activity strips per member with time and label. Every strip at data density, dozens of small fields visible. REAL CONTENT ONLY: session names gs-backend-claude (role lead, head claude, model fable, account acct-a, 5h 74%), gs-backend-builder and gs-backend-builder2 (role builder, head claude-deepseek, model deepseek-flash, window "not reported by provider"); messages: "packet GS-41: promoter bookkeeping lives on fly raw. build, run parity, report" from the lead to builder 1 at 13:41, "GS-41 done, see ledger" from builder 1 to the lead at 13:58, "packet GS-42: dearm the machine-update schedule" from the lead to builder 2 at 14:01; activity: "editing PromoterLedger.kt", "running checks/gate.sh", "searching for fly_raw", "reading MANIFEST.toml", "messaging a peer session". EXCLUSIONS: no aircraft, radar, runway or airport imagery; no logos; no browser chrome; no prices or benchmarks; no invented company names; no lorem ipsum; no glow. A render that could hang as a poster is wrong: this is a working screen whose job (see the team, read who is driving, read the last hand-off) must be readable from the image alone.
